title: Game Map Viewer — game.json
description: Contract for a single game's map configuration, produced by nes_decoder and consumed by the map_viewer web app. See CONTRACT.md.

id.description: Stable game identifier. Must match the registry entry and the res/{id}/ folder name.

version.description: Optional contract version this file was produced against (currently 1). Lets a future breaking change be detected instead of silently misread.

defaultMap.description: Key in `maps` shown first and treated as the navigation root (usually "world_map").

localizedString.description: Display text keyed by language code. At least one entry required; `en` is the fallback.

type.description: Render mode: a single image, or a pre-rendered tile pyramid (tilesPath).

image.description: Path to the map image, relative to this game.json's folder (res/{id}/).

thumbnail.description: Optional low-res placeholder for progressive loading. Only used when `width` and `height` are also present.

width.description: Optional intrinsic pixel width of `image`. Lets the viewer skip probing the full image.

tileSize.description: Tile size in pixels; drives the grid overlay and the editor's snap-to-grid. Typically 16.

floorGroup.description: Optional building/dungeon key: maps sharing it are floors of one place and get an in-map floor switcher. Must be STABLE across re-exports (derive from map table facts, not enumeration order).

floor.description: Floor number within `floorGroup` (1 = ground, negative = basement: -1 renders B1F). Drives switcher order and labels.

tilesPath.description: Tile URL template for type=tiles, relative to the game res dir (e.g. world_tiles/{z}/{x}_{y}.png); latlng space stays full-res pixels.

minNativeZoom.description: Lowest pre-rendered pyramid level for type=tiles (default -5).

pois.description: Points of interest (treasure chests, etc.) shown as icons.

events.description: Event-driven tile changes (e.g. a wall opening); each is a toggleable overlay.

event.description: A terrain change a map applies when a story event fires; toggled by a checkbox in the viewer.

overlay.description: Path to the changed-tiles overlay image, relative to this game.json's folder.

tiles.description: Number of tiles this event changes.

trigger.description: A clickable zone that navigates to another map (a door / exit / warp).

target.description: Key of the destination map within this same game's `maps`. Must reference an existing map (referential integrity is not expressible in JSON Schema — validate separately).

poi.description: A point of interest on a map (e.g. a treasure chest).

pos.description: Pixel position [x, y] (top-left of the tile), full-resolution image space.

item.description: Optional item id/hex for treasure POIs.

icon.description: Optional sprite image path (relative to the game's res dir); rendered as the marker instead of a glyph, on every map.

iconSize.description: Native pixel size [w, h] of `icon` (defaults to [16, 32]).

hidden.description: True when the collectible has NO visible sprite in the rendered map image (buried / Itemfinder-style items). Only these get an attention glyph in the viewer; visible chests rely on their baked-in sprite + a hover zone.

party.description: Optional structured battle party (a trainer's Pokémon, an enemy general's army…); the viewer renders it as an icon/name/badge card in the tooltip and makes the POI markable. Full roster, in battle order — do not truncate.

reward.description: Optional defeat reward (prize money, spoils…), pre-formatted (e.g. "¥624"). Shown dimmed in the party-card header.

partyMember.description: One member of a POI's battle party, rendered as an icon · name · badge row.

value.description: Numeric badge, right-aligned (a level, a troop count…). Omit for a name-only row.

unit.description: Localized badge prefix shown dimmed before `value`. Default "Lv" — e.g. {"zh": "兵"} renders 兵12000.

id.description: Optional game-internal id of this member (species / general id), for debugging/stability.

icon.description: Optional mini-icon path (relative to the game's res dir). Missing icon → the viewer shows a placeholder; the row layout is unaffected.

bounds.description: Axis-aligned rectangle in FULL-RESOLUTION image pixels: [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]], top-left origin.
